jd_requirements.title: AI Enablement Intern
jd_requirements.education_requirement: Currently pursuing B.Tech (AI/ML specialisation) or M.Tech (AI/ML)
key_responsibilities: Integrate LLM capabilities (OpenAI GPT / Claude / Gemini) into existing enterprise software systems
Build and deploy RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines for internal knowledge bases
Design and implement AI agents using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or CrewAI
Work with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Qdrant) for semantic search features
Develop REST APIs using FastAPI or similar to expose AI features to business applications
Collaborate with the engineering team to automate repetitive business workflows using AI
Document AI systems, prompt designs, and integration guides for the broader team
Present technical findings and progress to senior leadership
